Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 110. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: Super Saiyan 3 and Golden Great Ape Feat.
You no longer need to make control checks for using
Super Saiyan 2 while using Great Ape. While using
Great Ape you may now use Super Saiyan 3 but make
Berserk Checks at disadvantage while it is active.
Golden Great Ape
Kyoung Hwan Kim
